extra.reason: x86-64 for benchmarking first (no RISC-V board yet); RISC-V smoke-tested continuously from day one via harness/smoke-riscv.sh. RISC-V performance is the higher priority once hardware exists.
Vendored as a submodule at sonic/vendor/nanopass, pinned at bb47b56. Identity-pass smoke test green under Chez 10.0.0.

Option (d): FP contraction is an explicit, lexically-scoped, NAMED permission, default OFF, using the same mechanism as check suppression per D5. Reassociation stays forbidden and is revisited when a real reduction benchmark enters the matrix.
sonic/doc/register-partition.md: RV64 14 value / 11 raw / 32 float, x86-64 8 value / 5 raw / 16 float, with structural registers named per target.
sonic/vendor/nanopass at bb47b56; identity pass over a two-form language round-trips a fixture unchanged under Chez 10.0.0.
sonic/src/sonic/lang.ss: Lcore and Lanf in nanopass. 15 lang tests pass, including four rejection tests proving the grammar refuses undeclared forms at expansion time.

sonic/doc/gc-metadata.md: separate vocabularies per target. RV64 adds ra-live? (return address is an interior pointer in a register), a scratch bitmap rather than x86's nesting, and vl-live? for RVV vector-length state.

(sonic read) lands an R7RS datum reader; test/read-test.ss is 132 checks, 0 failures, and its core is a differential round-trip of all six bench/nbody Scheme sources against Chez's own read, datum by datum plus every flonum through number->string, with 27 negative cases so the reader refuses malformed input.

Numeric tower landed in sonic/src/sonic/numeric.ss. Fixnum and flonum only, no bignum/ratnum/complex. Tag scheme: 3 tag bits, fixnum tag 000, 64-bit word, so 61 value bits and range [-2^60, 2^60-1] = [-1152921504606846976, 1152921504606846975], which is what CUJ.md stage 8 already assumed and is also Chez's width so the hosted model shares the host's overflow boundary. Overflow documented and tested under all three controls: checked signals overflow-check with no bignum promotion; unchecked is UB and wraps two's-complement mod 2^61 with the tag surviving; proved emits unchecked code and is auditable via proved-audit, which accuses the analysis rather than the program. Flonums are IEEE binary64, one correctly rounded op per primitive, contraction never applied per D24, with a witness triple in the suite where one rounding and two differ by ~1.9x. 324 checks, 0 failures.

Primitives landed in sonic/src/sonic/prims.ss. All 33 primitives from the frozen table in lang.ss and nothing else, as a data table keyed by symbol with the control input as an argument, matching Lcore's (primcall pr c e* ...). checked runs the named check and signals a sonic-condition carrying the check name, who, and irritants; unchecked and proved emit identical code, and only proved is auditable. Bounds, type and overflow checks are separately named so they can be counted by name per D5. prims.ss deliberately does not import (sonic lang) to keep the runtime independent of the compiler's IR library; the two tables are cross-checked in both directions by the test. Every primitive nbody uses is covered, plus an end-to-end b[i*7+k] kernel asserted bit-identical under all three controls. Test: cd sonic && scheme -q --libdirs src:vendor/nanopass --script test/numeric-test.ss -> 324 checks, 0 failures.
primcall now carries ([pn c] ...), one control per applicable check, with prim-checks declaring which apply. 'bounds elided, type still checked' is expressible and tested.
flneg added as the normative spelling; SPEC.md states it and why (fl- 0.0 x) is not equivalent.
fixnum?, flonum?, vector?, flvector? and error added, so config-2c's predicate guards are expressible in Lcore.

div-check made reachable via fxquotient/fxremainder/fxmodulo (fl/ deliberately excluded, IEEE says infinity); fl> and fl>= added since NaN makes them underivable from fl<=; arity stated per primitive with mandatory fill on make-vector/make-flvector.

Lssa, Lrepr and Lmach added to lang.ss, each a nanopass diff against its predecessor. 25 lang tests including three construct-standalone tests and two rejection tests. A pass author can build valid input for their stage with no upstream pass in existence.
